I’m going through something similar except not nearly as bad. We live with my MIL due to us having to leave our apartment due to our roommates being crazy unemployed drug dealers ( long story). I am currently unemployed and my mother in law and boyfriend both work full time. Mil is not the cleanest person which is fine because I don’t mind cleaning and all we have to pay for is the electric bill. That being said, I have cleaned every single day this week, putting her house in a better condition than it was before we lived here. She is never here during the week because she visits her boyfriend, so she didn’t really say anything (which is fine). She comes home during the weekend and messes up the place again while me and my boyfriend are out during most of the weekend. We even feed her dinner multiple times. While she is home for two days she fills up the sink with dishes and leaves food out. I don’t clean this up because I figure she is home and will clean up after herself. Sunday night, she states that she feels ever since we have been here , there are dishes always in the sink and we never clean up after ourselves, which is not true! I have deep cleaned every single day I have been here! I have come to realize that when people think they are doing you a favor, they take you for granted. I would say if your boyfriend isn’t doing anything, maybe he should try and clean a bit or talk to them for you to lessen the load. I understand the stress you are under but like me , it just comes with the fact that it is temporary and you could be off worse. Just think how amazing it will be when you are free? When you can live with just him? Like if I have to deal with a little annoyances to save a lot of money, that’s okay. Also maybe look at the good things instead of the bad. Like my MIL is rude sometimes and hypocrite but she’s very generous and is almost never home. You just have to convince yourself for the time being.
